Clalit app for B1 holders
Question for those with Clalit on a B1 — how did you make an account and use their app?

I’ve found it’s impossible to do it myself on the app since I don’t have a TZ. I know my Clalit number but writing my passport number in place of TZ doesn’t work. 

I’ve spoken to about 20 Clalit reps on the phone and visited my home clinic to get their help, but they’ve all said it’s not possible without a TZ. Is this true?

I’m seeing doctors and getting tests done without any way of seeing the results other than a phone call…
